title: Mensuration: Surface Areas and Volumes of Solids

questions.question: The total surface area of a cube of edge 4 cm is:
questions.rationale: A cube has 6 square faces: TSA = 6a² = 6 × 16 = 96 cm²; 64 cm³ would be its volume.

questions.question: The volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm (π = 22/7) is:
questions.rationale: V = πr²h = (22/7) × 49 × 10 = 1540 cm³; 440 cm² is its curved surface area.

questions.question: A cone has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. Its slant height is:
questions.rationale: l = √(r² + h²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 cm — the 3-4-5 triangle formed by radius, height, and slant.

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm (π = 22/7) is:
questions.rationale: CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 10 = 440 cm²; 748 cm² is the total surface area including both lids.

questions.question: A cone and a cylinder have the same base radius and height. The cone's volume is what fraction of the cylinder's?
questions.rationale: Cone volume is (1/3)πr²h against the cylinder's πr²h — three cone-fills exactly fill the cylinder.

questions.question: The total surface area of a sphere of radius 7 cm (π = 22/7) is:
questions.rationale: TSA = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 49 = 4 × 154 = 616 cm²; 462 cm² is the total surface area of a hemisphere.

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius r is:
questions.rationale: Curved half-sphere 2πr² plus the flat circular lid πr² gives 3πr².

questions.question: A solid sphere of radius 6 cm is melted into a cone of base radius 6 cm. The cone's height is:
questions.rationale: Volume is conserved: (4/3)π(216) = (1/3)π(36)h, so 288π = 12πh and h = 24 cm.

questions.question: The volume of a sphere of radius 3 cm is:
questions.rationale: V = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π × 27 = 36π cm³; 27π would be r³ times π without the 4/3 factor.

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, its volume becomes:
questions.rationale: Volume scales with the cube of the radius: 2³ = 8, so doubling r multiplies volume by 8 (surface area only by 4).
